environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root. The Fargate task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group that only permits inbound TCP/8080 from the VPC endpoint ENIs (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) and denies all outbound except TCP/443 to the S3 VPC gateway endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a). Task role has no IMDS access (Fargate platform version 1.4.0 disables instance metadata). Subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate 1.4.0, awsvpc networking, isolated private subnet
config.security_group_inbound: TCP/8080 from sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 (VPC endpoint ENIs only)
config.security_group_outbound: TCP/443 to pl-63a5400a (S3 gateway endpoint prefix list) only, all other outbound DENIED
config.subnet_route_table: local VPC route + S3 gateway endpoint route only, no NAT, no IGW
config.imds: disabled (Fargate platform 1.4.0 - no instance metadata endpoint)
